text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Regent visits Salt city and urges focus on quality over quantity as means to deal with unemployment.
- Prince Hassan says Jordan needs to "solidify the advantage of stability by political, economic and social consensus."
- Prime Minister Kabariti visits the Ruwaished area and praises its inhabitants.
- Stocks in the Amman Financial Market post new advances in prices and volume.
- Jordanian ambassador in Israel expresses disquiet at delay in implementing Jordanian-Israeli peace treaty.
- Crown Prince says "there can be no sectarianism among King Hussein's family."
- Start of preparations for the resumption of the new session of parliament early next month.
- U.S. agreement to support Jordanian exports increases financing ability.
- Opposition deputies will not boycott the next session of parliament; they urge government to open a new chapter in ties with Iraq.
- End of salt and olive oil shortage.
